issues.title: RemoteToolkit.psm1 fails to import: drive-qualified variable parse error at line 38
issues.evidence: pwsh Import-Module -> 'RemoteToolkit FAILED TO IMPORT'; error 'Variable reference is not valid. : was not followed by a valid variable name character.' for "https://$ComputerName:$Port/wsman"
issues.risk: All Phase 2 remote execution (BatchScan, Invoke-RemoteQuickCheck, Invoke-RemoteNetworkDiagnostic) is dead on arrival
issues.business_impact: Multi-machine support feature (the primary Phase 2 value proposition) is non-functional
issues.developer_impact: Every Phase 2 script fails at Import-Module; must fix before any remote work

issues.title: Toolkit-Menu.bat never reads user input (no set /p)
issues.evidence: 19 references to %choice% but grep confirms set /p exists only in Setup-Wizard.bat; menu falls through to 'goto menu' at line 48
issues.risk: Master launcher loops forever; users cannot start any tool
issues.business_impact: Primary documented entry point (Setup-Guide.md:11) is broken for all users
issues.developer_impact: No tool is reachable via the menu; must add set /p choice and input loop
issues.suggested_fix: Insert 'set /p choice="Select an option: "' after the menu print, validate choice, only goto menu after running

issues.title: Firewall-Test.ps1 uses read-only automatic variable $host as loop variable
issues.evidence: pwsh: 'Cannot overwrite variable Host because it is read-only or constant.' at 'foreach ($host in $testHosts)'
issues.risk: Connectivity test loop throws at runtime; script cannot complete
issues.suggested_fix: Rename loop variable to $testHost and update references at lines 109-138

issues.title: Security: plaintext password passed on cmdkey command line
issues.evidence: cmdkey.exe /generic:$TargetName /user:... /pass:$($Credential.GetNetworkCredential().Password) - password visible in process args
issues.risk: Credential disclosure via process listing / audit logs / command-line history
issues.business_impact: Exposes credentials of supported machines; compliance risk
issues.developer_impact: Replace with Microsoft.PowerShell.SecretManagement or DPAPI-based storage
issues.suggested_fix: Use SecretManagement/SecretStore module; never place passwords in CLI arguments

issues.title: Unvalidated remote command execution with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
issues.evidence: & powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $networkScript with user-supplied $ToolkitRoot / $ComputerName and no validation
issues.risk: Remote code execution on fleet machines if config.json or machine list is tampered
issues.developer_impact: Add hostname/path validation; remove Bypass; sign scripts
issues.suggested_fix: Validate ComputerName against allowlist; use signed scripts; restrict config write access

issues.title: Get-ToolkitCredential is a non-functional stub (regex does not interpolate)
issues.evidence: 'Target: $TargetName' in single quotes -> literal match, never matches; function returns $null
issues.risk: Credential retrieval always fails; remote auth silently degraded
issues.developer_impact: Fix quoting; parse cmdkey output; or migrate to SecretManagement
issues.suggested_fix: Use double quotes or -like 'Target:*'; return parsed credential

issues.title: Regression suite fails 3 assertions (CSV header x2, alert severity)
issues.evidence: pwsh run: 'FAIL: CSV output contains header row' x2; 'FAIL: Disk threshold returns Critical'; exit 1
issues.risk: Fake green signal; docs claim tests pass (false)
issues.developer_impact: Use ConvertFrom-Csv; align AlertEngine default thresholds with test expectation
issues.suggested_fix: Fix assertions; rerun; update Scripts/README.md and ledger.json claims

issues.title: RemoteToolkit Pester tests reference non-existent -TimeoutSeconds parameter
issues.evidence: Test-RemoteConnection defines only ComputerName/Port/UseSSL; suite also cannot import module (CRIT-001)
issues.business_impact: No test coverage for remote feature
issues.developer_impact: Add TimeoutSeconds param or remove it; fix import first
issues.suggested_fix: After CRIT-001 fix, add a TimeoutSeconds parameter to Test-RemoteConnection or remove from test

issues.title: Documentation falsely claims 'All Phase 1 regression tests passed' and 'QA completed'
issues.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:56-64 'No incomplete features'; ledger.json statuses; actual suite exit 1
issues.business_impact: Untested/broken features may be treated as released
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run tests, fix failures, then update all status claims

issues.title: Remove-OldLogs deletes non-log files (documentation loss)
issues.evidence: Runtime test deleted Logs/README.txt (doc file) because LastWriteTime older than retention
issues.risk: Accidental deletion of README/other files in Logs
issues.developer_impact: Filter by file extension or dedicated subfolder
issues.suggested_fix: Only delete *.log / report files, or clean Logs/reports/ subtree

issues.title: Plaintext sensitive config; encryptSensitiveData=false; HTTP WinRM default
issues.evidence: "encryptSensitiveData": false; RemoteToolkit.psm1 uses http://.../wsman when UseSSL not passed; winrmSSL=false
issues.risk: Credential/traffic exposure over network and in cleartext config
issues.suggested_fix: Set winrmSSL=true; require -UseSSL for credential calls

issues.title: 4 duplicated Resolve-ToolPath / config bootstrap blocks

issues.business_impact: Config-handling bugs propagate to all scripts
